latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Semantic Scholar Search.

- Enables searching academic papers by keywords, title, or author via Semantic Scholar API
- Provides detailed paper info including abstract, authors, citations, venue, and publication year
- Supports author profile lookup with publication count and h-index
- Offers citation and reference data for any paper
- Outputs results to console or JSON, with optional export to file
